subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can say what the characters wear in The school show.
I can explain the problem in the story and Jack's idea.
I can give examples of not being wasteful.

tf.s: The school show is at three o'clock.
Jack and Sami are wearing trainers in the show.
tf.why: No, they aren't. They're wearing slippers.

tf.s: The jeans and shirts are too small.
tf.why: That is the problem in the story.

tf.s: Lily and Fatma are wearing pyjamas and baseball caps.
tf.why: Lily and Fatma are wearing dresses and hats.

tf.s: Jack says I've got an idea!
At the end, the children throw the old clothes away.
Leaving the water running is wasteful.
Putting coins in a money box is wasteful.
tf.why: Saving money is good. It is not wasteful.

tf.s: Atomic and Polly are wearing coats and jumpers.
tf.why: Yes! Atomic and Polly wear coats and jumpers.

boxes.q: What time is the school show?
Who is first in the show?
boxes.why: Hurry, Lily and Fatma. You're first.

boxes.q: Who is wearing coats and jumpers?
What is wrong with the jeans?
Who says I've got an idea!?
What do the children do with old clothes?
Are Jack and Sami wearing trainers?
Who says Are you ready for the school show?

boxes.why: The story teaches Don't be wasteful.

mcq.q: What are Jack and Sami wearing in the show?
mcq.why: They wear pyjamas, baseball caps and slippers.

mcq.q: Who is wearing dresses and hats?
mcq.why: They're wearing dresses and hats: Lily and Fatma.

mcq.q: What does Miss Razan say at the end?
Which is a short answer from the story questions?
mcq.why: We say Yes, they are. / No, they aren't.

mcq.q: A boy leaves the water running. Is it good?

o: Take only the food you can eat.
Leave the lights on all day.
mcq.why: Take only what you can eat.

mcq.q: What is the problem in the story?
o: The jeans and shirts are too small.
mcq.why: The clothes are too small to wear.

mcq.q: Why do the children recycle the old clothes?
o: They don't want to be wasteful.
mcq.why: Recycling means we are not wasteful.

mcq.q: Which old clothes can we reuse for a show?
mcq.why: We can reuse old clothes in a new way.
